subject: Could not find control namelist error

messages.author: Jisha B
messages.body:
Dear all,
I have been doing minimization on a DNA-RNA hybrid and on doing
minimization I get the could not find control namelist error. Could
someone help me with what might have happened? I have attached the
minimization script here.
Thank you

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
add a space before &cntrl, this is explained in Tutorial 1 which can be
helpful to work through.
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/basic/tutorial1
also I don't think you want the / at the end of restraintmask
